remarks: Lovingly maintained by its original owners, this sun-filled 3-bedroom ranch sits on 1.8 private, tree-lined acres in one of Wilton's most sought-after neighborhoods. Warm hardwood floors throughout the living room and dining area and main level bedrooms. Cozy family room with wood stove, plus a classic living room fireplace with firebox insert for twice the gathering space. Three comfortable bedrooms, 1.5 baths, and 1,379 heated sq. ft. of bright, inviting living. Attached 2-car garage. A rare sense of seclusion with mature trees and peaceful surroundings - yet just moments from Georgetown dining, shopping, and everyday conveniences. Top-rated Wilton schools nearby. A peaceful, private setting with everything close at hand. A truly special home, offered for the first time - don't miss this opportunity. Schedule your private showing today.
